name: Hezron
title: Son of Reuben and founder of a clan
summary: Hezron was one of the sons of Reuben, Jacob's firstborn son. He was the founder of the clan of the Hezronites and is counted among those who went with Jacob to Egypt. His descendants were recorded as one of the clans in the tribe of Reuben during the census on the plains of Moab.

keyEvents.title: Born as a son of Reuben
keyEvents.description: Hezron was born as one of the four sons of Reuben, Jacob's firstborn son with Leah.

keyEvents.title: The Journey to Egypt
keyEvents.description: Hezron was among Jacob's descendants who went down to Egypt with the whole family when there was famine in Canaan.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Israel
keyEvents.description: Hesjon is recorded in the genealogy of Reuben's sons as part of Israel's twelve tribes.

keyEvents.title: The clan of the Hesjonites at the census
keyEvents.description: At the census on the plains of Moab, Hesjon's descendants were registered as the clan of the Hesjonites within the tribe of Reuben.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Hesjon is recorded in the detailed genealogy of 1 Chronicles as part of the history of the tribe of Reuben.
